artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: NEW discriminate_facts(facts, s3=None): reads each name's landed raw through load_raw_for_key + prepare_header (S3 reads only), returns one dict per (security, mnemonic). A fact is RESOLVED only when a cross-field ratio falls in the band of exactly one of the two hypotheses (MILLIONS scale 1e6, ABSOLUTE scale 1). Bands: CURR_ENTP_VAL/CUR_MKT_CAP 0.2-5.0; |NET_DEBT|/CUR_MKT_CAP 0.02-10.0; SALES_REV_TURN/CUR_MKT_CAP and BEST_SALES/CUR_MKT_CAP 0.02-20.0; SALES_REV_TURN/(REVENUE_PER_SH x IS_SH_FOR_DILUTED_EPS) 0.5-2.0. Anchors relied on only when classify_unit measures them on that name; CRNCY must equal EQY_FUND_CRNCY. field_map.json not written; CLI main() untouched.

10 offline tests with stub raw (monkeypatched load_raw_for_key/prepare_header, no network): consistent millions resolves, consistent absolute resolves, revenue vs per-share x shares resolves, PLANTED inconsistent ratio (in no band) stays UNRESOLVED, planted disagreeing reads stay UNRESOLVED, missing anchor stays UNRESOLVED, cross-currency stays UNRESOLVED, absent value and undefined mnemonic stay UNRESOLVED, no raw landed is UNRESOLVED, bands cannot both hit.
